create_retrace_loss: create a Retrace multi-step off-policy loss computation op given Q-values, rewards, and policy probabilities
build_retrace_core_target: build Retrace core loss subgraph with temporally-offset Q-values and target network gradients
compute_off_policy_targets: compute general off-policy corrected multi-step targets for various importance-weighted algorithms
calculate_retrace_weights: calculate Retrace importance weights clamped at 1.0 from target and behaviour policy probabilities
define_retrace_core_extra: define a namedtuple holding Retrace core extra fields for retrace weights and target values
